findings.title: Recurring-event calendar deletions are not awaited
findings.body: The async callback awaits `getCalendar` before adding deletion promises to `apiDeletes`, but `forEach` does not wait for its callbacks. Execution can reach the later `Promise.all(apiDeletes)` while the array is still empty, so cancellation returns without deleting the recurring bookings from calendars; the deletions may also continue after the request has completed.

findings.title: All app imports are started eagerly
findings.body: Each `import()` is evaluated as soon as this module loads, so importing the app store starts loading every app package rather than loading only the app needed by a request. This retains the startup work and dependency-loading cost the async-import change appears intended to avoid, and can increase memory and cold-start time.
